Report on AI

History of LLMs

Language models evolved from n-gram statistics through recurrent networks to the transformer architecture introduced in 2017, followed by large pretrained models.

How LLMs Work

Large language models tokenize text, embed tokens, and use stacked attention layers to predict the next token, trained on large corpora and refined with human feedback.

Applications

Common uses include writing assistance, code generation, search, translation, summarization, and customer support.

Implications

LLMs affect productivity, education, and labor markets, and raise questions about accuracy, bias, privacy, and misuse.

Data Centers

Training and serving LLMs relies on data centers full of accelerators, with large demands for electricity, cooling, and water.
